jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Executive Assistant & Project coordinator**

**Status:** Part-Time (25-30 hours/week, Monday–Friday)

**Pay:** $20.00- $22.00/hour, depending on experience

**Benefits:** Employees working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, paid holidays, PTO, and 401(k) with company matching. Employees working fewer than 30 hours per week are eligible for sick time only

**Location:** Brea, CA

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to support our company owners with administrative tasks, research, and various projects. The ideal candidate can manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively, work independently, and follow tasks through to completion with minimal direction.

We are looking for a natural problem-solver who takes initiative, embraces technology and AI, and continually looks for smarter ways to work.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements.
* Create presentations, PowerPoint slide decks, spreadsheets, and business documents.
* Conduct research and assist with company projects and new clinic location setups.
* Organize tasks, track deadlines, coordinate projects, and ensure follow-through.
* Manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Communicate professionally and proactively with internal and external contacts.
* Identify problems, find solutions, and take initiative without constant direction.
* Utilize AI tools to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and support research and communication.
* Maintain organized records and handle confidential information appropriately.

Requirements:

**Job Requirements**

* Previous experience in an executive assistant, administrative, or similar role preferred.
* Exceptional organizational, multitasking, and time management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Resourceful, proactive, and able to work independently.
* Strong follow-through and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Comfortable learning new software and navigating multiple technology platforms.
* Strong AI proficiency, including effective prompt writing and the ability to apply AI tools to everyday business tasks.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information.

**Technology & AI Proficiency**

AI and technology are important to this role. Candidates should be comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency, support research and writing, organize information, and streamline administrative processes. The ability to create effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated results for accuracy, and use technology to identify smarter ways of working is essential.

**Resourcefulness is our number one priority.** We want someone who takes ownership, anticipates needs, solves problems, and gets things done without needing constant direction. The right candidate is organized, adaptable, an excellent communicator, and always looking for ways to work smarter and more efficiently.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Coordinator

**Location:** Buena Park, CA | Onsite  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Temp-to-Hire  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM  
**Compensation:** $26.00–$27.00 per hour, depending on qualifications

Job Summary

The Project Coordinator is responsible for supporting daily project operations, including preparing quotes, processing orders, and coordinating project details with customers, vendors, and internal teams. This role helps ensure accurate data entry, effective communication, and timely completion of project-related tasks. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities while providing excellent customer service.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate quotes and process orders, including entering data accurately from a variety of sources into a company's software system.
* Provide support in coordinating project details by working with customers and internal teams to ensure all aspects of the project are addressed.
* Coordinate RFQ (Request for Quotation) and project information with the sales team, vendors, factory, and managers.
* Perform customer service tasks in a polite, professional, and friendly manner.
* Assist in special projects as needed under the Project Manager's direction.
* Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Possess a minimum of 3 years of customer service experience.
* Demonstrate the ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions in a manner consistent with the essential job functions.
* Demonstrate proficiency in MS Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Possess strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively as a team player.
* Demonstrate the ability to multitask regularly and meet deadlines.
* Possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrate resourcefulness, initiative, and a professional and mature attitude.
* Possess strong project management skills.

**Preferred:**

* Possess experience in the hospitality industry.

**Job Overview**

As a Project Coordinator, you’ll keep projects organized and moving forward by coordinating schedules, maintaining accurate records, and supporting clear communication with clients and colleagues. You’ll also help manage day-to-day office needs, respond to inquiries, and keep project information easy to access. Your impact: By keeping timelines, records, and communications on track, you help project teams stay focused and clients receive timely, organized support.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate calendars, meetings, project schedules, and follow-up tasks.
* Enter and update project data, maintain spreadsheets, and organize digital and paper files.
* Support office management, front desk coverage, multi-line phone systems, and customer service.
* Prepare documents using word processing and productivity software; assist with routine clerical and administrative tasks.
* Communicate with clients and team members, provide customer support, and handle calls with professional phone etiquette.

**Skills**

* Strong organizational and time management skills, with attention to detail and reliable typing and data entry.
* Computer literacy and technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, and other productivity software; QuickBooks experience is useful.
* Office experience, including administrative or clerical work, filing, front desk duties, and phone communication.
* Customer service and client communication skills; experience with multi-line phone systems is preferred.
* Personal assistant experience and calendar management are helpful. Bilingual ability is a plus; it is not required.

Pay: $26.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operations Project Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**What You Will Do:**
---------------------

**GFT** is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Shared Services team in Long Beach, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance in Long Beach, CA.

**What you’ll be challenged to do:**

The Operations Project Coordinator II provides project management, administrative, and accounting support to project teams, particularly for large, complex, and high-risk clients/projects, in collaboration with Project Accounting.

**In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:**

* Prepares fee proposal templates, draft contracts, and subcontracts for review.
* Ensures projects adhere to contract language and requirements; issues and tracks project amendment documentation and coordinates for review.
* Develops WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) and Project Authorization forms including budgets and client invoicing requirements.
* Monitors project financials including variance, revenue, budgets, and WIP; responsible for follow up on revenue variance issues; participates in resolving issues.
* Partners with Collections Specialist to aid in project cash flow from clients.
* Serves as a liaison between internal staff, suppliers, and clients while communicating effectively on behalf of Project Managers.
* Conducts pre-bill reviews with Project Managers as necessary.
* Participates in monthly project review meetings and collaborates with Business Operations teams.
* Assists Business Operations with analysis of project budget performance.
* Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

**Education | Experience:**
---------------------------

**What you will bring to our firm:**

* Bachelor's degree in related field or 4+ years of relevant experience in project accounting, project controls, proposals, or contracts.
* 2+ years of relevant experience in project controls, proposals, or contracts.
* Knowledge or awareness of financial and general accounting, business math, AR, AP, and related processes.
* Industry terminology knowledge such as client contracts, awards, procurement, overhead, fee types, and multipliers.
* Desire to learn and apply industry key concepts such as effort, revenue, and variance analysis.
* Ability to manage assignments efficiently.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, multitask, and adapt to changing priorities.

**Compensation: $70,000 - $80,000, Salary dependent upon experience and geographic location**

### **Featured Benefits:**

* Hybrid (in-person and remote) work environment.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including wellness programs, parental leave, and pet insurance, in addition to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance.
* Tax-deferred 401(k) savings plan.
* Competitive paid time off (PTO) accrual.
* Tuition reimbursement for continued education.
* Commitment to professional development, access to internal and external training programs, and support of active participation in professional organizations.
* Incentive compensation for eligible positions.

**Company Overview:**
---------------------

At GFT, a privately held AEC firm, we innovate where transportation, water, power and buildings converge. We call this the Infrastructure of Life. We measure our success by the strength of our relationships – that’s why we’re the employer of choice for 5,000+ of the industry’s brightest engineers, planners, architects, inspectors, designers, and more.  
  
Our clients choose us for our expertise and prefer us for our nimble approach, creativity, and personal touch. Backed by over a century’s experience, together we’re building a lasting legacy for future generations: stronger communities, a healthier planet, and better lives. **GFT: Ingenuity That Shapes Lives™**

GFT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veterans’ status or other characteristics protected by law.

*Unsolicited resumes from third party agencies will be considered the property of GFT.*

Location: Long Beach, CA  
Working Hours: 8 AM – 5 PM  
Employment Status: Full-time

jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Custom Design Projects
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator — Custom Design Projects**  
**Dorell Fabric Studio | Fountain Valley, CA**

**Love Design, But Don't Want to Sell It?**

If you've ever thought, *“I love design, but I don't want to be the one selling it,”* this might be exactly the role you've been looking for.

Maybe you're the person who loves organizing, juggling a dozen moving parts, solving problems, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You appreciate beautiful fabrics, custom window treatments, and thoughtfully designed spaces—but what really satisfies you is **making things happen**.

At Dorell, our Design Consultants work with clients to create beautiful solutions for their homes. As a Project Coordinator, you'll be the person who helps bring those plans to life—coordinating the details, the people, and the process that turn a great design into a beautifully completed project.

**What You'll Do**

You'll help manage custom window treatment and related design projects from the early planning stages through fabrication, delivery, installation, and completion.

You'll work closely with the Design Consultant responsible for each project, along with clients, fabric suppliers, independent workrooms, installers, and other partners, to make sure all the moving pieces come together and each project progresses smoothly.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Keep projects moving.** Track multiple projects through their various stages, knowing what's been completed, what's outstanding, and what needs to happen next.
* **Bring the details together.** Help gather pricing, measurements, specifications, fabric information, workroom requirements, and other details needed to prepare accurate proposals and orders.
* **Catch things before they become problems.** Review project information for completeness and accuracy, identify missing pieces, and proactively follow up before they cause delays or mistakes.
* **Coordinate the people involved.** Work with Design Consultants, vendors, workrooms, installers, and clients to make sure everyone has the information they need, when they need it.
* **Keep everyone informed.** Communicate proactively about project status, timelines, next steps, and changes so clients and colleagues aren't left wondering what's happening.
* **Follow through to the finish.** Help coordinate production, quality checks, delivery, installation, and the resolution of any issues along the way.
* **Help us get better.** Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, documentation, and systems as our custom design business grows.

You'll be juggling multiple projects, each with its own details, deadlines, people, and priorities. If that sounds energizing rather than overwhelming, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**A True Partnership With Our Design Consultants**

Our Design Consultants work with clients to understand their vision, explore possibilities, and develop solutions that reflect their style, needs, and budget.

**The Design Consultant owns the client relationship and design direction.**

**You own the operational progression that turns that design direction into a beautifully completed project.**

That doesn't mean waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. You'll know where projects stand, anticipate what's needed, follow up, and keep things moving.

You'll also become another trusted point of contact for our clients—someone who knows their project, communicates clearly, and gives them confidence that the details are being handled.

Together, you and the Design Consultant help deliver an experience that's as thoughtful and professional as the finished result.

**You'll Probably Love This Role If You...**

* Are naturally organized and enjoy keeping lots of moving parts straight.
* Get satisfaction from checking things off, solving puzzles, and making progress.
* Notice details other people sometimes miss.
* Can juggle multiple projects and changing priorities without losing your sense of direction.
* Communicate clearly, warmly, and professionally—with clients as well as colleagues and vendors.
* Follow through without needing someone to remind you.
* Are comfortable asking questions, tracking down answers, and taking initiative.
* Enjoy working with people who bring different skills and perspectives to a project.
* Appreciate beautiful design, craftsmanship, and the care that goes into custom work.
* Like improving systems and finding better ways to get things done.

Most importantly, you care about the outcome. You don't just want a project marked complete—you want it completed **well**.

**What Experience Will Help You Succeed?**

You may already have experience coordinating projects, managing orders, scheduling production, or keeping complex work organized.

Experience in custom window treatments, drapery, interior design, furniture, cabinetry, construction, or another made-to-order business would certainly be valuable.

But you don't necessarily need to come from our industry.

We're equally interested in someone who has developed strong project coordination skills elsewhere and is excited about applying them in a creative, design-focused environment.

What matters most is that you bring:

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Experience managing multiple tasks, projects, or orders simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of follow-through.
* Comfort using and learning project-management applications and everyday business technology to keep work organized and moving forward.
* A practical, solutions-oriented approach to problems.
* The ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients, and outside partners.

**Why Dorell?**

We're building something special: a more connected, thoughtful way to help people create beautiful spaces.

That means bringing together talented design professionals, exceptional products, skilled craftspeo

jobs.title: Leadership Development Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join LA’s BEST as a Leadership Development Program Coordinator to Grow Leaders and Inspire the Next Generation!**

  

**About LA’s BEST**

LA’s BEST is a public/private partnership between the City of Los Angeles, the Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD), and the private sector, working together to provide safe, engaging, and enriching afterschool programming for elementary school students. Established 38 years ago, LA’s BEST serves children in neighborhoods with the greatest needs but the fewest resources, ensuring access to meaningful learning experiences beyond the school day.

Through this public-private partnership, LAUSD operates the program, the City of Los Angeles provides crucial public support, and the nonprofit entity advocates for funding and resources. This shared commitment allows LA’s BEST to provide high-quality enrichment activities that nurture academic growth, social-emotional well-being for students while also supporting working families across Los Angeles.

At LA’s BEST, we believe that diversity fuels innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every individual's unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are valued and celebrated. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds. Join us in our mission to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to thrive and contribute their best work. Your voice matters, and we invite you to bring your authentic self to our team.

**Job Overview & Responsibilities**

Reporting to the Director of Leadership Development, the **Leadership Development Program Coordinator** supports the design, coordination, and implementation of training programs that enhance staff leadership, youth development competencies, and professional growth at LA’s BEST. This position collaborates with internal teams and field staff to facilitate in-person and digital training, provide coaching and mentorship, and ensure alignment with the organization's mission and values for over one hundred staff members. The **Leadership Development Program Coordinator** also manages training logistics, supports curriculum development, and contributes to continuous quality improvement efforts across 200+ sites, strengthening the leadership pipeline and professional capacity of site staff at LA’s BEST. Core responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

Training Program Development & Facilitation (approximately 50%):

* Design, develop, and deliver engaging in-person and digital training programs that enhance leadership skills and youth development competencies for LA’s BEST Site Coordinators and Area Program Supervisors (APS).
* Ensure training content aligns with LA’s BEST’s mission, values, and youth development principles.
* Facilitate workshops, coaching sessions, and hands-on learning experiences to support staff professional growth and program quality.
* Collaborate with leadership and field staff to assess training needs and develop targeted learning opportunities.
* Develop and curate training materials, presentations, and digital learning content for online platforms.

  

Staff Coaching & Professional Development Support (approximately 25%):

* Mentor and provide ongoing coaching to Leadership Development APSs (supporting over 200 sites), equipping them with the skills to train and support Site Coordinators and APSs effectively.
* Implement systems of accountability and quality control to ensure staff development initiatives lead to measurable improvements in performance and program effectiveness.
* Partner with internal teams to identify best practices and ensure alignment across all professional development efforts.

  

Program Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement (approximately 15%):

* Assist with the logistics and execution of leadership development programs, including communication systems, scheduling, and training event coordination.
* Collaborate with cross-departmental teams to integrate leadership development efforts into broader organizational initiatives.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners to enhance training offerings and support ongoing professional learning opportunities for Site Coordinators and APSs.
* Represent LA’s BEST’s values, youth development principles, and technical assistance (TA) strategies in all training and leadership development initiatives.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support the organization’s mission and goals.

  

Data Assessment & Continuous Improvement (approximately 10%):

* Track training participation, engagement, and effectiveness to assess program impact and identify areas for improvement.
* Utilize data and feedback from staff to refine training programs and ensure continuous learning and development.
* Support the development of reports and assessments related to training effectiveness, learning outcomes, and leadership growth.
* Stay informed on industry trends, youth development research, and training methodologies to enhance the quality of professional development programs.

  

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to maintain regular and consistent attendance.
* Strong ability to develop and deliver engaging in-person and digital training programs.
* Knowledge of youth development principles and best practices in leadership training.
* Ability to create interactive learning experiences that align with LA’s BEST mission and values.
* Proficiency in instructional design and adult learning methodologies.
* Skilled in mentoring and coaching staff to enhance leadership skills and program quality.
* Strong understanding of professional development strategies and leadership pipeline development.
* Strong relationship-building skills to collaborate with internal

jobs.title: Administrative Program Specialist
jobs.description:
Please go to http://www.hacla.org/careers for details of this position and to apply.
  
  
**Special Note:** The posted salary is an estimate of the potential annual pay. Final offer will be dependent on qualifications and experience.
  
  
\*\*\*Position is open until filled\*\*\*

**SUMMARY:** Under general direction this position is responsible to plan, organize, coordinate, implement and evaluate one or more assigned functions or program areas such as digital inclusion & literacy, child care, youth development, fund raising and sponsor identification, community and cultural arts, recreational services, family and senior services, or other assigned functions; conducts administrative studies and analysis to solve problems of budget, organization, program, procedure, employee utilization, capital projects or equipment; service coordination, develops and recommends program guidelines, standards, procedures, policies and protocols; develops schedules, priorities, reports and standards for achieving program goals.
  
  
This position will oversee the utilization and programming of the Housing Authority’s Computer Labs and other public spaces to be centers for learning, engagement, wellness and positive activity; develop and implement best practice programmatic and capital investments to improve functionality and outcomes; seek out and nurture partnerships with other organizations to leverage resources and bring consistent, meaningful programs and opportunities to residents of public and affordable housing. This position will participate in a team focused on people-based strategies to impact the economic, health and educational trajectories of Housing Authority residents.

**PRINICIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****:**
  
Meets and contacts a wide variety of community partners promoting and implementing programs for Housing Authority clients. Must also assist the staff of Housing Authority in establishing and maintaining program services. Acts as a liaison for the Housing Authority; meets with representatives of various agencies, community groups, and service providers in coordinating services provided to Housing Authority clients, confers with staff on program problems and resolves issues and problems; prepares and reviews reports on the effectiveness of program activities and prepares executive briefings, special and annual reports. Prepares program budget requests; develops Request for Proposals (RFP)/scope of work for procurement of client services; administers contracts with outside service providers; prepare and administer grant proposals. Establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with a variety of individuals, community groups, service providers, sponsors, and agencies; conduct and attend meetings to provide information, enlist support, resolve issues, and plan/coordinate activities. Participate with a variety of Housing Authority committees, study groups, and task forces; attend a variety of meetings including staff and departmental meetings. Participates in collaborative meetings and acts as a liaison to communicate with partners and HACLA. Prepare and make oral and written presentations before Board of Commissioners, committees, community groups, professional groups and other agency bodies to coordinate, improve, and stimulate interest in the program and to secure financial support. May supervise and evaluate the performance of assigned staff; prepare and/or oversee the preparation of training, operational manuals, educational materials and information of assigned program areas; also be able to perform related duties as required.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES****:**
  
Requires knowledge of principles and practices of public and business administration, social services programs, including organization, personnel and fiscal management, and program management; statistical and research methods;; oral and written communication skills; applicable sections of federal, state and local rules, regulations, and laws; technical aspects of assigned functions and program areas; public speaking; budget preparation and administration; and supervision. Knowledge of community outreach and engagement is preferred with experience working with large collaborations and/or contract teams.
  
  
Ability to coordinate and perform a variety of complex administrative and staff duties; develop working technical knowledge of a variety of unrelated areas quickly and accurately; work independently with little direction; establish and maintain effective working relations with others; meet schedules and timelines; plan, develop and administer programs; research data and prepare reports; communicate effectively both orally and in writing; work confidentially with discretion; present ideas and concepts persuasively in speaking before groups or writing for publication; interpret, apply and explain laws, codes, regulations, policies, and procedures; analyze situations accurately and adopt effective course of action; supervise assigned staff and work collaboratively in a team environment.  
  
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**
  
Any combination of education and experience that is equivalent to a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with major course work in public administration, business administration, social work or a closely related field, and three (3) years of increasingly responsible experience in a professional program administration experience including at least one year in field of assignment.
  
  
**Special Requirement:** Must possess current valid California driver's license.

Applications will be reviewed for relevant experience, education, and training. Applications must be detailed and complete for proper evaluation. Resumes may be included but may not be submitted in lieu of application content. **Only the MOST QUALIFIED APPLICANTS will be invited to the interview process**. jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through
* undefined
* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events

* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects

jobs.title: Office Manager & Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**  
Hybron is an advanced manufacturing company that is building lightweight composites at mass production scale. At Hybron, we have pioneered a new composites manufacturing process that enables complex, high-performance composite parts to be produced 10-100 times faster than traditional manufacturing, at a fraction of the cost.  
  
We recently closed an oversubscribed $25M seed round, are backed by the Northrop Grumman Technology Accelerator, and are rapidly growing to commercialize and mass produce composite products at a scale never seen before. Our current focus is applying our proprietary process to composite artillery shells, solid rocket motor nozzles, gas turbine engine components, and airframes.  
  
If you want to join a rapidly growing company working on cutting edge composites technology while building capabilities for the warfighter and reshoring U.S. manufacturing, then we want to speak with you.  
  
**About the Role**  
This is a full-time, in-person role at our Hawthorne facility. As you will be working at an early-stage deep tech startup, this role will span many different tasks. Along with these high expectations comes the opportunity to significantly influence the development, strategy, and trajectory of a fast-growing startup company. Your work will tangibly impact our company and the composites industry, and you will be able to make rapid professional gains in an environment that encourages growth and innovation.  
  
This is a hands-on role. About half of your time will go to running the office and facility: vendors, supplies, visitors, shipping & receiving, and the systems that keep a growing, security-conscious team productive and compliant. The other half goes to supporting our leadership team: calendars, travel, reservations, expense reports, meetings, notes, filings and the details that let them stay focused on customers, investors, and the team. You’ll report to our CEO and work closely with our leadership team. You’ll also support the company as a whole with company-sponsored events and swag, as well as people functions such as onboarding and offboarding.  
  
This role requires a high-trust, self-starting generalist. You are a great fit if you can operate with autonomy in high-energy, fast-growing companies, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are great at juggling several responsibilities. You excel in prioritizing the important things, and are able to protect focus time on executives’ calendars. If you are highly organized, discreet, and calm under pressure, who take ownership and enjoy building systems in a fast-moving startup, we want you.  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* U.S. Person status pursuant to the EAR and ITAR definitions.
* 3+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or in another fast-paced environment.
* Available to work full-time, Monday–Friday, in person at our Hawthorne facility.
* Exceptional proactive organization and follow-through: you keep many details moving at once and close every loop.
* Excellent prioritization skills, knowing what is urgent and what is important.
* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential, sensitive, and export-controlled information, knowing when to take action and when to ask for clarity.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with employees, executives, vendors, and visitors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, and quick to learn new software.
* Calm, service-minded, and resourceful under pressure.

  
**Nice to Haves**

* Experience in a defense, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment, including familiarity with ITAR, CMMC, or visitor control.
* Experience managing facility, IT, or security vendors and service contracts.
* Accounts payable, bookkeeping, or spend-management tool experience.
* Event planning experience.

  
**Growth Opportunity and Targets**  
As you grow with Hybron, your responsibilities are expected to shift and evolve:

* Build out our workplace as we scale: lead facility expansions and new sites, and own the facilities budget and vendor contracts.
* Hire and lead a small office and facilities team (front desk, facilities, and admin support) as headcount grows.
* Extend your support to new executives as the leadership team grows.
* Take on conference and trade show logistics, including registrations, travel, and shipping booth materials.

  
**Compensation and Schedule**

* $70,000 - $95,000 per year
* Significant stock options in the company
* Potential additional compensation
* Mondays – Fridays in-person

  
**Benefits**

* Paid time off
  + Vacation – 10+ working days per year
  + Sick – 5 working days per year
* Hybron observes a generous company-official holiday schedule
* Daily lunches provided by the company
* 401(k) with employer-matched contributions up to 4% of salary
* Healthcare benefits
  + Medical insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Dental insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Vision insurance – 95% EE, 75% DEP employer contribution
  + Life, short and long-term disability insurance – 100% company covered

  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.

**ABOUT US**  
Pomelo is a boutique NYC-based staffing company. We began as an offshore recruiting firm and have recently evolved into an executive search firm that places top-tier US-based business generalists (former consultants and investment bankers) in operating roles at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. We work with some of the fastest-growing tech companies and iconic consumer brands, from New York to San Francisco.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
We are building a pool of exceptional Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner candidates for opportunities at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. EAs work closely with founders, CEOs, and executive teams to drive high-priority initiatives, solve complex business problems, and help the company operate more effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that can span strategy, operations, special projects, business development, finance, and organizational planning. We are specifically looking for candidates with a strong business generalist background, particularly former management consultants or investment bankers who have demonstrated exceptional analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. As opportunities arise, selected candidates will be considered for EA roles that match their experience, interests, and career goals.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the right hand to the executives for all administrative and operational tasks, helping the executives save time and resources

* Proactively follow-up with timely reminders and to-do lists

* Actively listen to executives' feedback and gather insights to constantly identify opportunities for business improvement

* Perform ad hoc administrative, business operations, and special project tasks as needed
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leadership and help ensure key priorities continue moving forward

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2-4 years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm or investment bank required**
* Exceptional candidates may have additional experience at a high-growth startup, technology company, or other operating environment
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems with limited direction
* Excellent analytical, financial modeling, and quantitative skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders.

Compensation will vary by company, seniority, and location. Typical EA opportunities in our network offer competitive base salary and bonuses.

Pomelo works directly with candidates throughout the search process to identify opportunities that align with their background, career goals, and interests.

jobs.title: YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator**

**About the Role**  
The YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator manages the day-to-day execution of assigned YouthBeat PRO client  
relationships. The role sits between high-level account strategy and the production work needed to deliver on each client’s communications scope. The Coordinator keeps client communication responsive, translates priorities into production briefs and assignments, tracks approvals and deliverables, and makes sure monthly commitments are completed and documented. The Account Coordinator is not expected to independently set pricing, contract scope, major creative direction, crisis response, or organization-level strategy. The role creates enough structure and client follow-through for the Director / Communications Lead to focus on growth, relationships, strategy, creative direction, and higher-stakes decisions.

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Client Onboarding & Account Setup**

* Set up new accounts using YouthBeat’s standard client onboarding process, including account brief, goals, audiences, platforms, content pillars, cadence, approval path, access, shared folders, meeting rhythm, and scope tracker.
* Confirm who can approve content, which assets are available, what media-release or privacy rules apply, and which client contacts own program information before production begins.
* Document client preferences and recurring needs so knowledge does not live only in meetings or one person’s inbox.

**Weekly Account Management & Client Communication**

* Prepare for and participate in recurring client meetings with a current view of upcoming content, open approvals, needed assets, recent performance, and next steps.
* Send or document clear follow-ups after meetings, including decisions, owners, deadlines, requested assets, and unresolved questions.
* Maintain routine professional communication with client contacts and follow up before missing information threatens a deliverable.
* Flag relationship concerns, repeated approval delays, major changes in direction, or requests that may affect scope to the Director / Communications Lead.

**Content Planning & Production Coordination**

* Maintain each assigned account’s content calendar and translate approved priorities into specific posts, Stories, Reels, graphics, photo/video assignments, field coverage, and community-management tasks.
* Create production briefs that identify objective, audience, platform, deliverable, assets, context, deadline, approval path, and client-specific standards.
* Coordinate assignments across apprentices and production contributors; make sure work is distributed realistically against deadlines and available hours.
* Complete first-pass review for accuracy, brand alignment, accessibility basics, release status, spelling, links, tags, and completeness before final approval.
* Consolidate revisions and keep the next action and deadline visible.

**Apprentice Management & Learning**

* Assign meaningful client work to YB PRO apprentices with clear briefs, examples, due dates, and review expectations.

* Confirm apprentices understand the client, audience, brand voice, file structure, and professional expectations before independent assignments.
* Provide routine coaching and first-line feedback and coordinate revisions before work advances.
* Work with the Communications Coordinator and Director / Communications Lead to identify portfolio-ready projects, training needs, and readiness for more responsibility.

**Deliverables, Scope & Reporting**  

* Track contracted deliverables, production units, posting commitments, community-management time, meetings, and other recurring responsibilities throughout the month.
* Maintain organized client folders with briefs, assets, working files, approvals, final exports, published links, reports, and meeting documentation.
* Identify out-of-scope requests before YouthBeat commits additional time or deliverables and escalate scope or pricing questions.
* Prepare monthly account reports summarizing completed work, performance highlights, key wins, challenges, outstanding items, and next priorities.
* Use performance and client feedback to recommend practical workflow or content adjustments for leadership review.
* Ensure client media is properly managed and archived by apprentices and junior producers, according to our policies.

**Role Authority & Escalation**

The Account Coordinator may manage routine client communication, production coordination, calendars, assignments, first-pass review, approval tracking, approved publishing, and account reporting. The role may not independently change contract scope, pricing, major strategy, public positions, crisis response, sensitive youth or personnel communications, or commitments that create new YouthBeat obligations.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong client-service and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, approvals, requests, and contributors.
* Professional written and verbal communication, including comfort leading routine client check-ins.
* Experience in communications, social media, marketing, content production, account coordination, community engagement, or related work.
* Working knowledge of content calendars, social publishing, basic analytics, and photo/video/graphic production workflows.
* Ability to coach young people professionally while still protecting client quality standards and deadlines.
* Strong judgment around confidentiality, consent, youth safety, scope boundaries, and escalation.
* Experience with Google Workspace, Asana or similar tools, Hootsuite or another scheduler, Mailchimp, Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, or comparable platforms is preferred.

**Expected Schedule & Capacity**  
The role is expected to begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week supporting a typical portfolio of 2–4 active client accounts, depending on each account’s scope, production volume, meeting cadence, and field-coverage ne

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Five88 & The Coronet)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self-reliance and personal growth.  
  
Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project-access.org/success-stories/

**The opportunity**

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

  

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth & Families, Health & Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Coordinate and oversee diversified programs, activities and special events for seniors, including bingo, arts and crafts, monthly birthday parties, and lite exercise programs, as space permits.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop & maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan & facilitate community-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information & referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door-to-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect & submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* Bilingual English/Cantonese or English/Mandarin preferred
* Four years of experience in multi-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in:
* + after-school programs or educational settings for youth
  + social services working with seniors.
  + serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self-starter, multi-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance

**Company Description**

SGS is the global leader and innovator in inspection, verification, testing and certification services. Founded in 1878, SGS is recognized as the global benchmark in quality and integrity. With over 97,000 employees in 130 countries and operating a network of more than 2,400 offices and laboratories, we provide services to almost every industry by assuring quality and safety of products and services.

Trusted all over the world, SGS is a market leader because we put 100% passion, pride and innovation into everything we do. We encourage new ideas. We welcome people who challenge the way we do things. And we will be 100% committed to helping you reach your full potential.

 **Job Description**

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible account manager who can build long-term customer relationships while also actively creating new business opportunities.

This person does not need to be a hands-on test engineer, but should be comfortable discussing technologies such as PCIe, USB, and Ethernet etc with engineering customers, understanding their challenges, and connecting those needs with the appropriate testing or engineering services.

Experience in the test & measurement or independent testing laboratory industry would be a significant advantage, particularly for candidates who already understand the Silicon Valley semiconductor and electronics ecosystem.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* 5–8 years of experience in technical sales, account management, business development, or a related customer-facing role within the electronics, semiconductor, test & measurement, or engineering services industry.

* Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new business opportunities within both existing and prospective accounts. The role is expected to include approximately 30% business development / new opportunity creation in addition to account management responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of high-speed digital interfaces such as:
  + PCI Express (PCIe)
  + USB / USB4
  + HDMI
  + Displayport
  + Ethernet, and so on

The candidate is not expected to be a test engineer, but must have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineering customers, understand their product development and testing needs, and identify relevant business opportunities.

* Ability to understand customer product development cycles and translate technical requirements into appropriate testing, validation, compliance, interoperability, or engineering service opportunities.

* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a role that combines account ownership with proactive business development.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer sites within the Bay Area and occasionally outside the region as required.

Highly Preferred

* Previous sales or account management experience with a test laboratory, test & measurement equipment manufacturer, semiconductor company, or related engineering services organization.
* Existing relationships or experience working with semiconductor, computing, data center, networking, automotive, or consumer electronics companies in Silicon Valley.
* Familiarity with industry compliance and certification ecosystems such as PCI-SIG, USB-IF, Ethernet/IEEE, or other high-speed interface standards organizations.
* Experience selling technical services or solutions involving electrical compliance testing, protocol testing, interoperability testing, validation, or high-speed signal integrity.
* Demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts while developing new customers or new business within existing customers.

The expected salary for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 per year This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

**About DCL Logistics**

DCL Logistics is a leading 3PL and fulfillment partner helping fast-growing consumer brands scale their ecommerce and retail operations. For more than 40 years, we have provided technology-enabled fulfillment, logistics and value-added services to innovative brands across consumer electronics, beauty, wellness, CPG, healthcare and other high-growth categories.

We own and operate our fulfillment facilities and combine nationwide infrastructure, technology, automation and hands-on account management to deliver a high level of service to our customers.

**The Opportunity**

DCL is looking for an experienced **Sales Development Representative, (SDR) – 3PL / Ecommerce Fulfillment** to help build our next generation of customers.

This is not an entry-level SDR position. We're looking for someone who understands the 3PL, ecommerce fulfillment or logistics industry and knows how to identify, engage and qualify growing brands that may be ready for a new fulfillment partner.

You'll work closely with DCL's sales and marketing leadership to identify high-value prospects, develop outbound strategies and create qualified opportunities for the sales team.

The ideal candidate is competitive, curious and comfortable speaking with executives and operations leaders at growing consumer brands.

**Location Requirements:** This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and develop new business opportunities across ecommerce, retail and omnichannel brands
* Identify companies experiencing growth, fulfillment challenges, retail expansion or potential 3PL transition events
* Engage CEOs, founders, COOs, Heads of Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics leaders
* Qualify opportunities based on order volume, revenue, fulfillment requirements, technology, retail channels and growth plans
* Schedule qualified discovery meetings for DCL's sales team
* Research target accounts and develop personalized outreach strategies
* Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts and opportunities in HubSpot
* Partner with Marketing on campaigns, industry events and target-account strategies
* Consistently achieve weekly and monthly activity, meeting and pipeline goals

**What We're Looking For**

* **2+ years of SDR, BDR or business development experience**
* Experience within **3PL, ecommerce fulfillment, warehousing, logistics or supply chain** strongly preferred
* Proven success generating qualified meetings through outbound prospecting
* Comfortable engaging senior decision-makers
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience with CRM and sales prospecting platforms; HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience is a plus
* Understanding of Shopify, Amazon, retail fulfillment or ecommerce operations is a plus
* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a performance-driven sales environment
* Located in **Southern California or the San Francisco Bay Area**

**Who Will Be Especially Successful Here**

You've sold logistics or fulfillment before and understand the conversation.

You know what questions to ask when a brand is growing faster than its current operation can support. You recognize signals such as service problems, rising shipping costs, retail expansion, new funding, rapid ecommerce growth or dissatisfaction with an incumbent 3PL.

Most importantly, you enjoy prospecting and turning those signals into conversations.

**Career Growth**

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in logistics sales—not remain an SDR forever.

Successful performance in this position can create a path toward an **Account Executive / Sales role**, with the opportunity to own and close larger 3PL opportunities.

If you're currently selling or prospecting within ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, logistics or supply chain and you're ready for your next opportunity, we'd like to meet you.

**About DCL Logistics**

DCL Logistics is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace.

jobs.description:
**Harlem Children’s Zone (HCZ),** a world-renowned education and poverty-fighting organization based in New York, seeks an enthusiastic, dedicated, and mission-aligned **Community Coordinator.**

For more information, check out Want to Work at Harlem Children’s Zone? Here are 7 Things You Need to Know.

**Who You Are:**

The Community Coordinator will bring a passion for Harlem Children’s Zone's mission: breaking the cycle of intergenerational poverty with comprehensive, on-the-ground programming that builds opportunities for children and families to thrive in school, work, and life.

The Community Coordinator plays a vital role in fostering engagement, strengthening program implementation, and enhancing community partnerships within HCZ’s multi-generational community center. Serving youth, adults, and seniors, this role builds trusted relationships with participants and families, supports high-quality program delivery, and ensures that community voices are heard and reflected in the center’s activities. The Coordinator collaborates closely with program and leadership staff to promote consistent attendance, develop partnerships, and track outcomes aligned with HCZ’s mission of breaking the cycle of poverty.

**What You'll Do:**

### **Key Responsibilities:**

### **1. Family & Participant Engagement**

* Build meaningful connections with youth, adults, and senior participants.
* Serve as a primary liaison between the community center and families.
* Conduct outreach and maintain regular communication through phone calls, in-person meetings, and events.

### **2. Attendance and Retention Support**

* Track daily and weekly attendance across all program areas.
* Identify and address barriers to consistent participation.
* Implement strategies that improve retention and deepen participant investment.

### **3. Community and Partner Engagement**

* Develop and sustain partnerships with local organizations, service providers, and community leaders.
* Coordinate community events and support center-wide initiatives.
* Connect families to internal and external resources aligned with their needs and interests.

### **4. Program Development and Implementation**

* Lead daily operations and logistics of youth, adult, and senior programs.
* Collaborate with site staff to ensure high-quality, engaging, and culturally relevant programming.
* Offer input on program design and lead portions of programming when needed.
* Coordinate program logistics and maintain organized tracking of deliverables and timelines.

### **5. Data Tracking and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of attendance, engagement, and referral outcomes using designated systems.
* Prepare monthly reports and present findings to leadership.
* Use data to drive continuous program improvement.

**In-Person Schedule:**

**September** – **June:**

* Monday – Thursday (1pm-9pm), Saturdays (8am- 4pm)

**July** – **August:**

* Monday – Friday (10:30am- 6:30pm) and select Saturdays

* Associate's or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Education, Social Work, or a related field.
* 2+ years of experience working for a community-based or youth/family-serving organization.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across generations and cultures.
* Experience with program coordination, community outreach, or case management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or database systems for tracking and reporting.

  
**Benefits**

As a member of the Harlem Children's Zone team, you will join a supportive and inclusive community dedicated to helping children, families — and our staff — thrive. We offer highly competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator, Contract
jobs.description:
**About Treeswift**

In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead.

We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments.

Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms.

To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital.

We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia.

Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us.

**The Position:**

Treeswift is looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to support our hiring efforts as we continue to grow. You'll work closely with our recruiting team and hiring managers to coordinate interviews, manage candidate communication, and keep our recruiting processes organized and running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who is exceptionally detail-oriented, communicates well, and has experience working in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment. You'll own the day-to-day coordination of our hiring process while helping identify opportunities to improve how we work.

This is a good fit for someone who enjoys the operational side of recruiting, cares about the candidate experience, and wants to have a hand in building processes as the company scales.  
  
You will be a key member of the Recruiting team which sits as part of the People Operations organization.

**What You'll Do:**

* Own interview scheduling and coordination across multiple roles and hiring teams, including virtual and in-person interviews.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process, ensuring timely communication and a positive experience.
* Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to manage competing priorities, anticipate scheduling needs, and keep searches moving forward.
* Coordinate interview logistics, ensuring candidates and interviewers are prepared and have the information they need.
* Identify opportunities to improve recruiting workflows and help build more efficient processes as we scale.
* Build and maintain recruiting processes, documentation, templates, and resources.
* Support day-to-day recruiting operations in Ashby (our ATS), including managing job postings, maintaining accurate candidate records, coordinating offers, and keeping hiring workflows up to date.
* Help strengthen our candidate experience and employer brand through thoughtful, consistent communication.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and internal stakeholders to support a smooth hiring process.
* Support sourcing efforts as needed, including candidate outreach and pipeline management.
* Help the recruiting team stay organized and adapt as hiring priorities shift.
* Proactively flag issues, suggest improvements, and take ownership of resolving them.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* You have 1–3+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, recruiting operations, sourcing, or people operations at an early-stage or high-growth company.
* You're exceptionally organized and detail-oriented. You catch the small things, keep track of moving pieces, and take pride in getting things right.
* You're a strong communicator. You know how to work with different stakeholders, keep people informed, and build good relationships across a team.
* You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change and processes aren't always fully built out.
* You look for ways to make things better. You're not afraid to suggest a new approach or take ownership of improving an existing process.
* You care about candidate experience and understand the importance of representing the company well throughout the hiring process.
* You're proactive and reliable. When you own something, people can count on you to follow through.
* You're comfortable working in an ATS and understand the importance of maintaining accurate recruiting data.
* You're based in NYC and comfortable being in the office regularly.

**What We Value:**
------------------

* **Mission first.** We value team members who are focused on working towards the best outcomes for the customer and the business.
* **Curiosity**. We are constantly learning – from each other and from our customers.. We aren’t afraid to learn we were wrong in the process and adapt our approach accordingly.

**Ownership mindset**. If you see an opportunity for improvement, run with it. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere, no matter your role.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and equity package
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents
* Life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents
* Flexible, unlimited paid time off
* 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Free OneMedical membership
* Commuter benefits

jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th century’s most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: *“Don’t undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.”*  
  
In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

**The Role**

As the Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding Polaroid's footprint across independent retailers, distributors, resellers, and e-commerce marketplaces. We are looking for an experienced account manager with strong business acumen, execution skills, and a deep understanding of retail and online sales channels to deliver profitable customer growth and increase market share.

This role will be responsible for managing key reseller and distributor relationships, supporting marketplace growth initiatives, monitoring channel compliance, and protecting the integrity of the Polaroid brand across retail and e-commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience with Amazon and other online marketplaces, retail channel management, MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance, listing optimization, and the Photo Specialty retail channel.

In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Focus on growing and developing existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities across retail, reseller, distributor, and marketplace channels.
* Manage the total account relationship, including new business acquisition, customer retention, expansion opportunities, and strategic account planning.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with distributors, resellers, and specialty photo retailers to achieve sales and profitability goals.
* Achieve revenue, profit, and market share targets for assigned accounts and strategic channel partners.
* Lead new market penetration initiatives and optimize existing channel performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to plan and execute product launches, promotions, events, and marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and maximize ROI.
* Conduct product and assortment planning with retail and online partners to drive mutually beneficial business results.
* Create and maintain sales forecasts and demand plans to support business planning and inventory management.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and market trends to recommend pricing, assortment, and promotional strategies.
* Monitor sell-through performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Set up, maintain, and optimize product content, imagery, and merchandising assets across retailer and marketplace portals.
* Monitor listing health, content compliance, product availability, and brand representation across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Ensure all marketplace listings comply with Polaroid brand guidelines, content standards, and retailer requirements.
* Monitor and enforce MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance across reseller, distributor, and online marketplace channels.
* Protect and monitor retail and e-commerce channels to identify unauthorized sellers, pricing violations, diversion, and brand integrity concerns.
* Manage and support marketplace reseller relationships to ensure compliance, profitability, and sustainable growth.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve content, inventory, operational, and fulfillment issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of account management, sales, e-commerce, or channel management experience.
* Familiar working with Amazon and other major online marketplaces.
* Experience managing distributors, resellers, and specialty retail accounts.
* Strong knowledge of MAP compliance, channel management, and brand protection best practices.
* Understanding of marketplace listing health, product content optimization, and digital merchandising.
* Experience in consumer electronics, photography, imaging, or Photo Specialty retail channels preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, forecasting, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and account management tools.

**AI in our hiring process**

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

**Our Approach to AI**

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

Compensation Range: $95K - $120K
