jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About HungryPanda / 关于熊猫外卖**

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, HungryPanda connects people with authentic Chinese and Asian food through its delivery platform. We work with restaurants, grocery businesses, and local teams to help more people discover the food they love.

Our next opportunity in the U.S. is to make HungryPanda known and used by a wider audience. We are looking for a marketing leader who can see the bigger picture, build a plan for growth, and work hands-on with the team to make it happen.

在美国，我们希望让更广泛的消费者认识并使用 HungryPanda。我们正在寻找一位既有全局视角、又愿意亲自投入执行的市场负责人，带领团队把增长计划变成实际成果。

**About the Role / 岗位介绍**

You will lead digital marketing for the U.S. market, with a clear goal: help more people discover HungryPanda, place their first order, and keep coming back. You will build on our connection with Chinese-speaking communities while finding effective ways to reach a broader U.S. audience.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set priorities and guide the team, while staying close to campaign planning, channel tests, creative work, and performance data. You should be comfortable making strategic decisions and rolling up your sleeves to improve execution.

你将负责美国市场的数字营销工作，目标明确：让更多消费者认识 HungryPanda、完成首次下单，并愿意持续使用。你需要在服务好现有华语用户群体的基础上，探索如何有效触达更广泛的美国消费者。

这是一个需要亲自参与执行的管理岗位。你将确定方向、带领团队，同时深入参与活动策划、渠道测试、内容创意和数据复盘。我们希望你既能做出有依据的策略判断，也能与团队一起把执行做好。

**What You’ll Do / 工作职责**

* **Build a U.S. growth plan.** Identify priority audiences and markets, set clear acquisition and retention goals, and decide where marketing time and budget will have the greatest impact.制定美国市场增长计划。 明确重点用户及城市，设定用户获取与留存目标，并判断团队精力和营销预算应投入在哪里。
* **Bring HungryPanda to a wider audience.** Develop messaging and campaigns that make the platform relevant to Chinese-speaking customers and to other U.S. consumers interested in Asian food. Test what helps new audiences understand, trust, and try the service.让更多消费者接受 HungryPanda。 针对华语用户，以及对亚洲美食感兴趣的更广泛美国消费者，制定合适的传播内容和活动，测试哪些方式能促使新用户了解、信任并尝试平台。
* **Lead channels and campaigns hands-on.** Guide work across Xiaohongshu (RED), Instagram, WeChat communities, TikTok, paid digital channels, and other relevant platforms. Get directly involved in briefs, creative reviews, launches, and improvements when needed.亲自参与渠道及活动执行。 统筹小红书、Instagram、微信社群、TikTok、付费数字渠道及其他合适的平台；根据需要亲自参与需求制定、内容审核、上线及优化。
* **Turn awareness into orders.** Work with Product, Operations, and local teams to understand the customer journey, improve first-order conversion, and create reasons for customers to order again.把品牌认知转化为订单。 与产品、运营及本地团队协作，了解用户从看到广告到完成下单的过程，改善首单转化，并推动复购。
* **Build effective creator and community programs.** Develop KOL/KOC, creator, and community partnerships that fit different audiences and markets; measure their contribution beyond views and engagement alone.建立有效的达人及社群合作。 针对不同用户和城市开展 KOL/KOC、内容创作者及社群合作，并关注其对实际业务增长的贡献。
* **Connect national direction with local execution.** Partner with City Managers and local Marketing teams to adapt campaigns to each market’s customers, merchants, and opportunities.结合全国方向与本地执行。与城市经理及本地市场团队合作，根据各城市的用户、商家和市场机会调整活动。
* **Use data to make decisions.** Track campaign spend and results, including customer acquisition, first orders, repeat orders, and channel performance. Run tests, share what works, and change course when results fall short.用数据指导决策。 跟踪活动投入与效果，包括新用户获取、首单、复购及渠道表现；通过测试总结有效做法，并及时调整效果不佳的方案。
* **Lead and develop the team.** Set clear priorities, coach team members, coordinate external partners, and maintain a high standard of execution across projects.带领并培养团队。 明确工作重点、指导团队成员、协调外部合作方，并确保各项目的执行质

**What You Bring / 任职要求**

* Strong experience in digital or growth marketing for a consumer platform, marketplace, food delivery business, or other consumer brand, including experience leading people or cross-functional work.具备消费平台、交易平台、外卖业务或其他消费品牌的数字营销或增长营销经验，并有带领团队或跨部门项目的经历。
* A track record of growing an audience and connecting marketing activity to measurable outcomes such as customer acquisition, first purchases, or retention.有扩大用户群体的实际成果，并能说明营销工作如何推动新用户获取、首次购买或留存。
* Ability to set a clear strategy and manage budgets, while remaining comfortable working directly on campaigns, creative, channel tests, and performance reviews.能够制定清晰策略、管理预算，同时愿意亲自参与活动、内容、渠道测试和效果复盘。
* A strong understanding of Chinese-speaking communities in the U.S., along with curiosity and sound judgment about how to reach a broader American audience.深入了解美国华语用户群体，同时有能力和判断力探索如何触达更广泛的美国消费者。
* Strong analytical, communication, and team leadership skills. Comfortable working with City Managers and teams across different functions.具备良好的数据分析、沟通和团队管理能力，能够与城市经理及不同职能团队有效合作。
* Fluency in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese and English is required.必须能流利使用普通话和英语进行口头及书面工作沟通。

If you enjoy building a growth strategy and getting close to the work that brings it to life, we’d love to hear from you.

如果你既喜欢制定增长方向，也愿意深入一线推动执行，欢迎加入我们，一起让更多美国消费者认识并选择 HungryPanda！

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Independent Sales Representative – Pharmacy & Healthcare Technology (1099 Commission-Based)

**Company:** AisleRx  
**Location:** New York and Ohio  
**Job Type:** Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** Commission-Based | Uncapped Earning Potential

About AisleRx

AisleRx is bringing innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies, helping pharmacy owners expand their service offerings and capitalize on new opportunities in the evolving healthcare marketplace.

We are seeking ambitious, self-motivated Independent Sales Representatives to introduce AisleRx to independent pharmacy owners and decision-makers throughout New York and Ohio.

This is an opportunity to represent an innovative healthcare solution, build relationships with local business owners, and earn commissions by helping pharmacies discover new ways to serve their customers.

The Opportunity

Are you a natural relationship-builder who enjoys connecting with business owners, opening doors, and turning conversations into business opportunities?

As an AisleRx Sales Representative, you will be responsible for identifying independent and regional pharmacies, establishing relationships with pharmacy owners, presenting the AisleRx solution, and developing opportunities for new business.

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on commission, with no guaranteed base salary**. It is ideal for a driven sales professional who values independence, flexibility, and the opportunity to grow earnings through results.

You will have the opportunity to leverage your existing professional network, develop new relationships in the pharmacy industry, and help independent pharmacies explore innovative healthcare solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Develop new business:** Identify and engage independent pharmacies that may benefit from AisleRx's telehealth solution.
* **Build owner relationships:** Connect directly with pharmacy owners, pharmacists-in-charge, and other key decision-makers.
* **Present AisleRx:** Clearly communicate the value proposition and explain how the solution may benefit independent pharmacies.
* **Generate sales opportunities:** Prospect, conduct outreach, schedule meetings, deliver presentations, and follow up with prospective customers.
* **Develop a territory:** Build a pipeline of qualified pharmacy prospects within your assigned geographic area.
* **Drive new partnerships:** Work with interested pharmacies to advance opportunities and convert prospects into customers.
* **Represent AisleRx professionally:** Build trust through knowledgeable conversations, consistent follow-through, and a customer-focused approach.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in people who are entrepreneurial, persuasive, professional, and motivated by results.

**Ideal candidates will have:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical sales, healthcare sales, medical device sales, or B2B sales.
* Existing relationships with independent pharmacy owners or other healthcare decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* The ability to prospect independently, generate leads, and develop new business.
* A self-starter mindset and the discipline to manage your own schedule and sales pipeline.
* A professional, consultative sales approach focused on understanding customer needs and communicating value.

**Especially attractive candidates include:**

* Former or current pharmaceutical and medical sales representatives.
* Individuals with established relationships in the independent pharmacy market.
* Pharmacy industry professionals with strong business development skills.
* Experienced B2B sales professionals who know how to reach decision-makers and close business.
* Independent sales agents looking to add an innovative healthcare solution to their portfolio.

Experience in pharmacy or healthcare sales is preferred, but proven sales ability and strong industry relationships are also valuable.

Compensation & Earning Potential

This is a commission-only, 1099 independent contractor opportunity designed for individuals who want their earnings to reflect their sales performance.

* **Commission-based compensation:** Earn commissions for qualifying sales under the AisleRx commission plan.
* **Uncapped earning potential:** Your earnings can grow as you develop your territory and generate new business.
* **Flexible schedule:** Manage your prospecting and sales activities independently.
* **Territory development:** Build relationships and a network of independent pharmacies in your market.
* **Meaningful opportunity:** Help independent pharmacies explore innovative solutions in a changing healthcare landscape.

There is no guaranteed base salary or hourly wage. Earnings will depend on sales results and the terms of the commission agreement.

Why Join AisleRx?

Independent pharmacies are an important part of their communities, and they need innovative solutions to remain competitive and meet evolving customer needs.

By representing AisleRx, you can help pharmacy owners discover new opportunities while building your own sales business.

If you have the relationships, drive, and ability to open doors, this is an opportunity to turn your sales experience into a rewarding business development opportunity.

Apply Today

If you are a motivated sales professional with a passion for healthcare, strong relationship-building skills, and the drive to succeed in a commission-based environment, we want to hear from you.

Join AisleRx and help bring innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies across New York and Ohio.

**AisleRx — Building partnerships with independent pharmacies.**

Pay: $1.00 - $400,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

Veterinary Business Operations Assistant

**Animal Hospital of Morris Park – Bronx, NY**

Animal Hospital of Morris Park is a busy veterinary hospital that has served the Bronx community for more than 30 years. We are looking for a motivated **Veterinary Business Operations Assistant** to work directly with hospital management on projects that improve how the practice operates.

This is a great opportunity for a college student, recent graduate, or early-career professional interested in **business operations, finance, data, inventory, healthcare management, or process improvement.**

This is not a traditional receptionist position. We are looking for someone who enjoys organizing information, working with numbers and spreadsheets, researching problems, and finding better ways to get things done.

What You'll Work On

* Creating spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and business summaries

* Comparing vendor pricing, expenses, subscriptions, and purchasing options

* Organizing policies, documents, and shared files
* Researching software, vendors, equipment, and business services

Your role will often be to **collect information, organize it clearly, compare options, and prepare it for management review.** Final financial, staffing, and business decisions remain with management.

* Highly organized and detail-oriented
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
* Good with numbers and data
* Curious and willing to research and solve problems
* Able to work independently
* Reliable and able to follow through
* Comfortable learning new software and systems

Previous veterinary experience is **not required**.

This position may be especially interesting for students or graduates studying **business, finance, accounting, business analytics, operations, supply chain, healthcare administration, economics, marketing, or entrepreneurship.**

What You'll Gain

You will work directly with hospital leadership and gain hands-on experience in areas such as business operations, financial analysis, inventory, vendor management, data reporting, recruiting, process improvement, software implementation, and healthcare administration.

We especially value people who see a messy process and think:

**"There has to be a better way to organize this."**

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.  
  
We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge—and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.  
  
Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities—we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

 **Job Description**

Equinox is looking for an Assistant Project Manager (APM) to help build our luxury fitness clubs. You will work across the entire project lifecycle, from early design and bidding through construction, and final handoff.

This is not just an administrative role. You will work alongside our Project Managers and Director of Construction, while actively coordinating with architects, engineers, general contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal teams to help keep projects organized, on schedule, and on budget. You will handle core project controls (budgets, schedules, RFIs, and submittals) while gaining the hands-on field experience needed to transition into running your own projects.

**What You’ll Do Daily**

* **Keep Projects on Schedule:** Track design deliverables, manage active logs for RFIs and submittals, and make sure design clarifications get answered before they delay the field.
* **Manage the Paperwork & Finances:** Maintain project budgets, cost reports, and schedules. Track contracts, change orders, and invoices, and review monthly contractor payment applications.
* **Support Preconstruction:** Assist with contractor bidding, bid leveling, scope reviews, and tracking long-lead materials.
* **On-Site Quality Control:** Travel to active construction sites to monitor progress. You will pay close attention to our high-end finishes, including custom millwork, specialty lighting, luxury tiling, and athletic flooring.
* **Drive Closeout & Handoff:** Manage punch lists, equipment commissioning, and closeout packages to ensure a seamless handoff to our Operations and Facilities teams.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Haves:**

* **2 to 5 years** of experience in commercial construction, working for a general contractor, owner's representative, architecture firm, or engineering firm.
* **Strong technical fundamentals:** You can confidently read architectural/structural/MEP drawings and understand basic commercial construction sequencing.
* **Proven organizational skills:** You can manage multiple spreadsheets, logs, and competing priorities without letting details slip through the cracks.
* **Travel flexibility:** Ability to travel extensively throughout the U.S. and internationally to oversee active job sites.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in **hospitality, luxury retail, or high-end commercial interiors**.
* Proficiency with industry software like **Procore, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Project**, along with advanced Excel skills.
* OSHA 10/30 certification or LEED credentials.

**Growth & Culture**

We don't expect you to be an assistant forever. This role is deliberately structured as a stepping stone. As you show capability, you will take independent ownership of larger project scopes.

At Equinox, our clubs are the core of our brand. You’ll be building highly sophisticated, design-driven spaces alongside a seasoned team of real estate, architecture, and construction professionals.

**Pay Transparency:** $85K – $110K

 **Additional Information**

**AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:**

* We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
* Complimentary Club membership
* Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

NOTE: This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at https://careers.equinox.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United Kingdom.

**Position:** Full-Time | In-Person  
**Schedule:** 40 hours per week, including Saturdays  
**Compensation:** $20–$25/hour, depending on experience *(proposed range)*

About C by Clear

C by Clear is a new luxury medical aesthetics destination in the heart of Union Square, New York City, founded by sisters Sarah and Clara Hong.

Backed by the decades of clinical expertise of Clear Laser Skin Clinic, C by Clear brings a fresh perspective to Korean aesthetics, combining advanced technology, personalized treatments, and thoughtful hospitality to deliver natural, understated results.

Rooted in the Korean philosophy of *jeongseong* (정성), the sincere and intentional care expressed through attention to every detail, our approach goes beyond treatments to create an elevated, welcoming experience for every client.

Our philosophy is simple: **The same you, at your best.**

About the Role

We are seeking a warm, polished, and highly organized **Front Desk Coordinator / Client Experience Specialist** to serve as the first point of contact for our clients.

As the face of C by Clear, you will play an essential role in shaping the client experience, from the initial inquiry and appointment booking to check-in, treatment coordination, and post-visit follow-up.

The ideal candidate has a natural passion for hospitality, beauty, and wellness, with an intuitive ability to anticipate client needs and deliver exceptional service. You will work closely with our founders and clinical providers to ensure seamless daily operations while helping build lasting client relationships.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing brand from the beginning and help establish the standard of care and hospitality that defines C by Clear.

What You'll Do

**Client Experience & Hospitality**

* Welcome clients with warmth and professionalism, creating a personalized and elevated experience from arrival to departure.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for client inquiries via phone, email, text, and in person.
* Anticipate client needs and maintain a calm, welcoming environment that reflects C by Clear's commitment to thoughtful hospitality.
* Build meaningful relationships with clients, remembering preferences and ensuring consistency across visits.
* Handle client questions, concerns, and special requests with discretion, empathy, and professionalism.

**Scheduling & Studio Operations**

* Maintain accurate client records and appointment information in the practice management system.
* Support daily opening and closing procedures, including preparing reception areas and reconciling payments.

* Monitor office supplies, retail inventory, and other front desk essentials.

* **Highly Organized:** You can manage multiple priorities, maintain attention to detail, and keep daily operations running smoothly.

* **Relationship-Oriented:** You naturally connect with people and enjoy building lasting client relationships.
* **Tech-Savvy:** You are comfortable learning new booking platforms, point-of-sale systems, and client management software.
* **Collaborative:** You thrive in a small, hands-on team and are willing to contribute wherever needed.

* 1–2+ years of experience in a client-facing role, preferably within luxury hospitality, high-end retail, beauty, wellness, or medical aesthetics.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with scheduling software, POS systems, and basic office technology.
* Experience with medical practice management software is a plus.
* Ability to maintain client confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA standards.
* Availability to work Saturdays and a flexible schedule based on business needs.
* Korean language proficiency is a plus, but not required.

Compensation & Perks

* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience.
* Employee discounts on C by Clear treatments and skincare products.
* Opportunities to experience select treatments and products as part of ongoing education, subject to eligibility and company policy.

jobs.title: Design Event Coordinator - Bold Catering & Design
jobs.description:
#### **Design Event Coordinator - Bold Catering & Design**

**For the detail-obsessed, solution-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves kind of person.**

There is something pretty incredible about watching an event come to life. The transformation of a space. The energy of a team working toward a shared vision. The moment when months of planning turn into an unforgettable experience.

But behind every extraordinary event is someone making sure every detail comes together.

**That's where you come in.**

We're looking for an **Event Coordinator** who thrives on the excitement, creativity, and occasional chaos of bringing exceptional events to life. Someone who can build a flawless timeline, anticipate a challenge before it becomes a problem, and jump into the action when the moment calls for it.

This isn't a behind-the-desk kind of role. You'll be involved in every stage of execution, from coordinating the moving pieces before an event to being on-site when it all comes together. You'll work alongside talented designers, floral teams, installation crews, and vendors to turn creative visions into remarkable experiences.

If you're energized by a fast-moving environment, take personal pride in delivering exceptional results, and believe no task is beneath you when it comes to getting the job done, we'd love to meet you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own the details.** Take the lead on event logistics, timelines, layouts, vendor coordination, and all the moving pieces that make an event successful.
* **Bring the vision to life.** Partner with design, floral, and installation teams to translate creative concepts into beautifully executed events.
* **Be the go-to person.** Build strong relationships with clients and vendors, communicate proactively, and ensure everyone feels confident and informed.
* **Make things happen.** Coordinate everything from venue walkthroughs and rental orders to staffing needs, special requests, and event-day logistics.
* **Be where the action is.** Show up on-site, oversee setup, guide teams, troubleshoot challenges, and lend a hand wherever it's needed.
* **Think three steps ahead.** Anticipate obstacles, adapt when plans change, and find solutions that keep the event moving forward.
* **Keep an eye on the numbers.** Track expenses, manage purchases, reconcile event costs, and help ensure each event is as financially successful as it is memorable.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
------------------------------

* **You're a doer.** You don't wait to be asked, and you're just as comfortable jumping into setup as you are managing a detailed production schedule.
* **You take ownership.** You follow through, hold yourself accountable, and care deeply about the quality of your work.
* **You thrive under pressure.** Tight timelines, competing priorities, and last-minute changes bring out your resourcefulness.
* **You're relentlessly organized.** Details matter to you, and you have the systems and discipline to keep multiple events moving simultaneously.
* **You're a natural collaborator.** You communicate clearly, build trust, and understand that great events require everyone working together.
* **You're flexible and adaptable.** You understand that the event calendar doesn't always follow a traditional workweek, and you're ready to be there when it matters.
* **You genuinely love hospitality.** Creating memorable experiences and exceeding expectations is what motivates you.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* Experience coordinating events, managing logistics, or working in event production or a related field.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working with vendors, managing budgets, and coordinating multiple priorities.
* Comfort using Microsoft Office and event management platforms; experience with Caterease, NOWSTA, Social Tables, or similar systems is a plus.
* Availability to work evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event schedules.
* Ability to be active on-site for extended periods and assist with event setup and breakdown, including lifting up to 50 pounds.

**Ready to Make It Happen?**
----------------------------

The most rewarding events don't happen by accident. They happen because passionate, talented people care enough to get every detail right.

If you're someone who finds satisfaction in a job well done, brings positive energy to a challenge, and loves being part of the team that makes the magic happen, **we want you on ours.**

**Apply today and help us create experiences worth remembering.**

jobs.description:
Position Description: Customer Account Manager (CAM)

Job Description

The Customer Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and represents their needs throughout the organization. This role builds lasting relationships and coordinates the internal activities required to deliver responsive, accurate service for technically engineered systems, from initial inquiry and quotation through order fulfillment and post-delivery support.

Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Operations, Production Planning, Purchasing, Quality, Logistics, and Finance, the Customer Account Manager translates customer requests into clear actions of supporting teams, establishes ownership and timelines, and follows through to resolution. Success requires technical aptitude, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across departments while keeping customers informed.

Key Responsibilities

* Customer relationships: Develop a thorough understanding of assigned accounts, their applications, business priorities, and service expectations. Maintain regular communication, build trust, and serve as the central contact for day-to-day requests and escalations.
* Cross-functional coordination: Translate customer needs into documented requirements, deliverables, owners, and due dates. Coordinate internal follow-up, resolve handoff gaps, and escalate competing priorities or overdue actions to the appropriate leaders.
* Records and improvement: Maintain accurate customer, quotation, order, and issue records in CRM and ERP systems. Share recurring customer feedback and recommend improvements to communication, service, and internal workflows.

Qualifications

* Experience in customer account management, technical customer service, inside sales, project coordination, or a similar role supporting business customers in manufacturing or an engineered-product environment.
* Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, open orders, and requests with different priorities and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information, communicate delays, and handle difficult customer conversations professionally.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experience using CRM, ERP, or order management systems.
* Experience supporting distributors, contractors, OEMs, or other commercial and industrial customers.

Measures of Success

* Timely acknowledgment, tracking, and resolution of customer requests, with clear ownership of open actions.
* Effective coordination of customer issues through corrective action and confirmed closure.
* Strong customer satisfaction and retention, with support for repeat business and account growth.

jobs.description:
The Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a critical role in driving business growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective customers. As the first point of contact for many potential clients, the SDR builds strong initial relationships, uncovers business needs, and generates qualified pipeline opportunities for the sales team. This role is ideal for a motivated, curious, and results driven individual who thrives in a fast paced, collaborative sales environment and is eager to grow a career in sales.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Media Studies, Advertising, Public Relations, Communications, Business Administration, or Sales

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly and persuasively convey complex ideas

jobs.description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

Asset Living is a third-party management firm and a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.

  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed’. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. * Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management

* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.
* Maintain property appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis (this requires regular property inspections and tours)
* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator (12-Week Contract)
jobs.description:
**About Curfew Labs**  
Curfew Labs builds software that makes work easier. Our flagship, Curfew Suite, is a family of connected business apps for time, expenses, books, projects and signatures on one account. We build quiet, dependable tools that do the tedious, load-bearing work so people don’t have to worry when they step away.

**The role**  
A 12-week contract to find out where our marketing should go next. This is an analytics role more than a creative one. You’ll set up and run paid campaigns across our advertising channels, make sure every click and sign-up can be traced back to where it came from, and measure what each new customer costs us to win and what they’re worth. Then you’ll tell us, with evidence, which bets to make. Our team handles the creative; you’ll brief it, test it and say what’s working. Expect 20 to 40 hours a week, set together at the start, and a hybrid schedule from our Chicago office.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own our tracking. Set a consistent UTM convention for every link and campaign, and put conversion tracking, ad platform pixels and analytics events in place. The goal is clean attribution from first click to paying customer.
* Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, TikTok, and OpenAI’s ChatGPT ads
* Track customer acquisition cost (CAC) by channel, campaign and audience, alongside conversion rates, return on ad spend and early lifetime value
* Analyze the customer lifecycle, from first visit to sign-up, activation and retention, using funnels and cohorts, and find the patterns behind who stays
* Design and run tests on audiences, offers, landing pages and budgets, with a clear hypothesis and read-out for each
* Build a simple dashboard and a weekly report that say plainly what’s working, what isn’t, and where to move spend
* Brief our team on creative and landing pages based on what the data shows
* Leave the tracking, the dashboard and a written playbook in good order, so the work carries on after the contract

**What you bring**

* Two or more years in performance or growth marketing, ideally for software or online services, with real responsibility for budgets and results
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads, and experience with or a strong interest in ChatGPT ads
* Strong command of UTMs, conversion tracking, pixels and attribution, and of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager or similar
* A track record of measuring CAC, return on ad spend and lifetime value, and of turning the numbers into decisions
* Experience with funnel, cohort and retention analysis; comfort with spreadsheets, and SQL a plus
* A habit of testing before scaling, and of reporting results honestly, including the ones that didn’t work
* A very organized way of working

**Contract details**

* 12 weeks, starting as soon as the right person is found
* 20 to 40 hours a week, agreed at the start based on campaign volume
* Hybrid: part of the week in our Chicago office, the rest remote
* $30 to $45 an hour

We work in the office and are open to hybrid schedules.

**Why Curfew Labs**  
We’re building business software around a simple idea: applications should work together naturally, so people spend less time managing tools and more time on the work that matters. People and AI work side by side at every stage of how we build and run the company: people set the direction and remain accountable, and AI helps us move faster. In this role, your analysis will shape where Curfew Labs invests next. Learn more about us at curfewlabs.com.

Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60625

jobs.title: Inbound Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Americaneagle.com is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Inbound Sales Coordinator to join our growing Business Development team. This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to start a career in sales and learn the business from the ground up.
  
  
As the first point of contact for prospective clients, you’ll handle inquiries that come in through phone calls, web form submissions, live chat, email, and internal referrals. You’ll respond quickly, learn to qualify each inquiry, route it to the right Sales Representative, and make sure every handoff includes the context needed to start the conversation well. Along the way, you’ll get hands-on experience with Salesforce, sales qualification, and the full sales process, plus training and coaching from experienced sales and business development professionals.
  
  
This is a great fit for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and energized by talking with people. Success in this role is measured by speed-to-lead, qualification accuracy, data quality, and how well inbound inquiries turn into real opportunities. Strong performers will have a clear path to grow into a Business Development Representative or other sales roles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Serve as the first point of contact for inbound inquiries across phone, web forms, live chat, email, and internal channels, providing a professional and responsive experience
* Respond to new inquiries promptly, following established response-time standards
* Qualify inbound leads by asking questions to understand the prospect’s needs, project scope, timeline, and budget, using the qualification process you’ll be trained on
* Route qualified leads to the right Sales Representative based on assignment
* Write clear, concise handoff notes that summarize each prospect’s needs and conversation history
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls between prospects and Sales Representatives
* Enter and maintain accurate lead, contact, account, and opportunity records in Salesforce, including logging activity and keeping data clean
* Direct non-sales inquiries (existing client support, vendor solicitations, job seekers) to the right internal teams
* Follow up with leads who haven’t responded or aren’t ready to move forward yet
* Support sales operations projects and other team initiatives during slower inbound periods, such as Salesforce data cleanup, list building, research, and reporting
* Take part in ongoing sales training, shadow sales calls, and build your knowledge of our services and the digital industry

  
**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Communications, Marketing, or a related field
* 0–2 years of professional experience in a Sales or Business Development role, with a genuine interest in building a career in sales
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a friendly, professional presence on the phone and in writing
* Strong listening skills and natural curiosity, with the ability to identify prospect needs and ask effective qualifying questions
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks, keep information accurate, and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven, with a coachable attitude and an eagerness to learn and grow
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Collaborative team player who works well with others
* Comfortable learning new software; experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus but not required
* Interest in digital marketing, web design and development, or technology is a plus
* Professional appearance and demeanor is expected

Americaneagle.com provides its employees with an energetic work environment and opportunities to further develop their skills. Our dedication to growing our development team is how we can produce excellent sites and applications for our clients. We do all of this while maintaining a family value focus and pushing for a good work-life balance. The US-based salary range for this full-time position is $60,000-$75,000 per year. Within this range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Americaneagle.com, we are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package, a positive work environment, company activities and more.

***Bisnow is looking for a hungry, high-potential entry-level Sales Representative to join our Commercial Real Estate Advertising and Event Sales team. In this role, you’ll partner with clients across the CRE industry to help them promote, market, and grow their brands through one of the most dynamic B2B media platforms in the country — and in the room at 400+ live events a year.***

***This isn’t a dead-end entry role. There’s a clear path to Business Manager and a genuine culture of developing and promoting from within. If you’re ambitious and coachable, this is the kind of place where your first job becomes your career.***

***This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago office (24 East Washington St.), in-office 3–4 days a week. We welcome candidates coming straight out of college or bringing experience from internships, coursework, or early professional roles.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.  
We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.
* Drive sponsorship sales for both digital and in-person events through sharp prospecting research, outreach, and follow-through from first contact to confirmed sponsor.
* Prospect new business daily to build a strong pipeline and develop into an expert at identifying and targeting the right people at the right companies.
* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

### **What's in it for you?**

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Operations Coordinator keeps our orders, inventory and shipments moving. You will own the day-to-day path from purchase order to delivered and invoiced, working with customers, distributors, suppliers, co-manufacturers, carriers and our third-party warehouses. It is a hands-on role that combines logistics, order processing, inventory control, customer service and some accounting support.

\*\*Schedule: \*\*Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. No weekends.

Reports to: Operations Director

\*\*Compensation: \*\*$26 per hour- 40 hour week based on experience, plus benefits

**Key Responsibilities**

Order Processing & Fulfillment (approx. 30%)

* Receive, enter and confirm customer purchase orders from distributors, wholesale accounts and direct customers, including EDI orders.

* Release orders to our third-party warehouses and confirm ship dates and quantities.

* Process and ship daily e-commerce orders (Amazon and other online channels) and stock Amazon FBA inventory.

* Generate and send invoices through EDI and QuickBooks Enterprise; send advance ship notices where required.

* Track open orders to completion and resolve shorts, substitutions, backorders and pricing discrepancies.

Logistics & Transportation (approx. 25%)

* Schedule inbound and outbound freight (LTL and full truckload) with carriers and freight brokers; get quotes and pick the most cost-effective option.

* Book delivery appointments with distributor DCs and arrange customer pickups.

* Coordinate inbound shipments from domestic suppliers and co-manufacturers, plus imported containers, working with our customs broker and freight forwarder on documents and arrival timing.

* Act as the main day-to-day contact for our third-party warehouses (receiving, picking, shipping, inventory reports and billing).

* Prepare and check shipping documents: bills of lading, packing lists, pallet labels and case labels.

* Handle freight claims, damages and carrier delays, and keep customers informed.

Inventory Control (approx. 20%)

* Keep inventory records accurate across several warehouse locations, and reconcile warehouse reports against our systems (QuickBooks and SkuVault).

* Prepare purchase orders to suppliers for approval, then follow up on confirmations and ship dates.

* Track lot codes and shelf life; rotate stock first-expired, first-out (FEFO) and flag slow-moving or aging inventory.

* Support cycle counts, physical inventories and inventory adjustments.

Customer Service (approx. 15%)

* Serve as the first point of contact for customer, distributor and broker questions about orders, status, pricing and product information.

* Answer phone and email questions promptly and professionally.

* Process returns, credits and deductions, working with accounting to resolve them.

* Keep customer setup paperwork up to date (vendor forms, item setup sheets, certificates of insurance, food-safety documents).

Accounting Support & Administration (approx. 10%)

* Enter accounts payable (supplier, freight and warehouse invoices) and accounts receivable in QuickBooks Enterprise.

* Match freight and warehouse bills to shipments before payment.

* Run routine reports (open orders, inventory, shipments, sales) for management.

* Other duties as assigned, including general office support.

Qualifications

Required

* 3 or more years of experience in order processing, logistics coordination, inventory control or customer service in a distribution, manufacturing or consumer products company.

* **Working experience with QuickBooks.**

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills (sorting, filtering, lookups, basic formulas) plus Outlook and Word.

* Very accurate with numbers and data entry.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

* Able to manage many open orders and deadlines at once and stay calm when plans change.

* High school diploma or GED.

Preferred

* Experience in foodservice, grocery or CPG, ideally with broadline distributors such as Sysco, US Foods, DOT Foods or Sygma.

* EDI experience.

* Experience working with third-party (3PL) warehouses and scheduling LTL and truckload freight.

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central / FBA, ShipStation or SkuVault.

* Familiarity with food-safety documentation, lot tracking and shelf-life management.

\*\*\*The Huntington Resource is an Equal Opportunity Employer – All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of the individual’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), marital status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

Hello. We’re Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th century’s most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: *“Don’t undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.”*  
  
In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

**The Role**

As the Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding Polaroid's footprint across independent retailers, distributors, resellers, and e-commerce marketplaces. We are looking for an experienced account manager with strong business acumen, execution skills, and a deep understanding of retail and online sales channels to deliver profitable customer growth and increase market share.

This role will be responsible for managing key reseller and distributor relationships, supporting marketplace growth initiatives, monitoring channel compliance, and protecting the integrity of the Polaroid brand across retail and e-commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience with Amazon and other online marketplaces, retail channel management, MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance, listing optimization, and the Photo Specialty retail channel.

In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Focus on growing and developing existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities across retail, reseller, distributor, and marketplace channels.
* Manage the total account relationship, including new business acquisition, customer retention, expansion opportunities, and strategic account planning.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with distributors, resellers, and specialty photo retailers to achieve sales and profitability goals.
* Achieve revenue, profit, and market share targets for assigned accounts and strategic channel partners.
* Lead new market penetration initiatives and optimize existing channel performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to plan and execute product launches, promotions, events, and marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and maximize ROI.
* Conduct product and assortment planning with retail and online partners to drive mutually beneficial business results.
* Create and maintain sales forecasts and demand plans to support business planning and inventory management.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and market trends to recommend pricing, assortment, and promotional strategies.
* Monitor sell-through performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Set up, maintain, and optimize product content, imagery, and merchandising assets across retailer and marketplace portals.
* Monitor listing health, content compliance, product availability, and brand representation across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Ensure all marketplace listings comply with Polaroid brand guidelines, content standards, and retailer requirements.
* Monitor and enforce MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance across reseller, distributor, and online marketplace channels.
* Protect and monitor retail and e-commerce channels to identify unauthorized sellers, pricing violations, diversion, and brand integrity concerns.
* Manage and support marketplace reseller relationships to ensure compliance, profitability, and sustainable growth.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve content, inventory, operational, and fulfillment issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of account management, sales, e-commerce, or channel management experience.
* Familiar working with Amazon and other major online marketplaces.
* Experience managing distributors, resellers, and specialty retail accounts.
* Strong knowledge of MAP compliance, channel management, and brand protection best practices.
* Understanding of marketplace listing health, product content optimization, and digital merchandising.
* Experience in consumer electronics, photography, imaging, or Photo Specialty retail channels preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, forecasting, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and account management tools.

**AI in our hiring process**

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

**Our Approach to AI**

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

Compensation Range: $95K - $120K

**Company:** AisleRx  
**Location:** New York and Ohio  
**Job Type:** Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** Commission-Based | Uncapped Earning Potential

About AisleRx

AisleRx is bringing innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies, helping pharmacy owners expand their service offerings and capitalize on new opportunities in the evolving healthcare marketplace.

We are seeking ambitious, self-motivated Independent Sales Representatives to introduce AisleRx to independent pharmacy owners and decision-makers throughout New York and Ohio.

This is an opportunity to represent an innovative healthcare solution, build relationships with local business owners, and earn commissions by helping pharmacies discover new ways to serve their customers.

The Opportunity

Are you a natural relationship-builder who enjoys connecting with business owners, opening doors, and turning conversations into business opportunities?

As an AisleRx Sales Representative, you will be responsible for identifying independent and regional pharmacies, establishing relationships with pharmacy owners, presenting the AisleRx solution, and developing opportunities for new business.

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on commission, with no guaranteed base salary**. It is ideal for a driven sales professional who values independence, flexibility, and the opportunity to grow earnings through results.

You will have the opportunity to leverage your existing professional network, develop new relationships in the pharmacy industry, and help independent pharmacies explore innovative healthcare solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Develop new business:** Identify and engage independent pharmacies that may benefit from AisleRx's telehealth solution.
* **Build owner relationships:** Connect directly with pharmacy owners, pharmacists-in-charge, and other key decision-makers.
* **Present AisleRx:** Clearly communicate the value proposition and explain how the solution may benefit independent pharmacies.
* **Generate sales opportunities:** Prospect, conduct outreach, schedule meetings, deliver presentations, and follow up with prospective customers.
* **Develop a territory:** Build a pipeline of qualified pharmacy prospects within your assigned geographic area.
* **Drive new partnerships:** Work with interested pharmacies to advance opportunities and convert prospects into customers.
* **Represent AisleRx professionally:** Build trust through knowledgeable conversations, consistent follow-through, and a customer-focused approach.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in people who are entrepreneurial, persuasive, professional, and motivated by results.

**Ideal candidates will have:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical sales, healthcare sales, medical device sales, or B2B sales.
* Existing relationships with independent pharmacy owners or other healthcare decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* The ability to prospect independently, generate leads, and develop new business.
* A self-starter mindset and the discipline to manage your own schedule and sales pipeline.
* A professional, consultative sales approach focused on understanding customer needs and communicating value.

**Especially attractive candidates include:**

* Former or current pharmaceutical and medical sales representatives.
* Individuals with established relationships in the independent pharmacy market.
* Pharmacy industry professionals with strong business development skills.
* Experienced B2B sales professionals who know how to reach decision-makers and close business.
* Independent sales agents looking to add an innovative healthcare solution to their portfolio.

Experience in pharmacy or healthcare sales is preferred, but proven sales ability and strong industry relationships are also valuable.

Compensation & Earning Potential

This is a commission-only, 1099 independent contractor opportunity designed for individuals who want their earnings to reflect their sales performance.

* **Commission-based compensation:** Earn commissions for qualifying sales under the AisleRx commission plan.
* **Uncapped earning potential:** Your earnings can grow as you develop your territory and generate new business.
* **Flexible schedule:** Manage your prospecting and sales activities independently.
* **Territory development:** Build relationships and a network of independent pharmacies in your market.
* **Meaningful opportunity:** Help independent pharmacies explore innovative solutions in a changing healthcare landscape.

There is no guaranteed base salary or hourly wage. Earnings will depend on sales results and the terms of the commission agreement.

Why Join AisleRx?

Independent pharmacies are an important part of their communities, and they need innovative solutions to remain competitive and meet evolving customer needs.

By representing AisleRx, you can help pharmacy owners discover new opportunities while building your own sales business.

If you have the relationships, drive, and ability to open doors, this is an opportunity to turn your sales experience into a rewarding business development opportunity.

Apply Today

If you are a motivated sales professional with a passion for healthcare, strong relationship-building skills, and the drive to succeed in a commission-based environment, we want to hear from you.

Join AisleRx and help bring innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies across New York and Ohio.

**AisleRx — Building partnerships with independent pharmacies.**

new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.  
  
We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge—and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.  
  
Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities—we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

 **Job Description**

Equinox is looking for an Assistant Project Manager (APM) to help build our luxury fitness clubs. You will work across the entire project lifecycle, from early design and bidding through construction, and final handoff.

This is not just an administrative role. You will work alongside our Project Managers and Director of Construction, while actively coordinating with architects, engineers, general contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal teams to help keep projects organized, on schedule, and on budget. You will handle core project controls (budgets, schedules, RFIs, and submittals) while gaining the hands-on field experience needed to transition into running your own projects.

**What You’ll Do Daily**

* **Keep Projects on Schedule:** Track design deliverables, manage active logs for RFIs and submittals, and make sure design clarifications get answered before they delay the field.
* **Manage the Paperwork & Finances:** Maintain project budgets, cost reports, and schedules. Track contracts, change orders, and invoices, and review monthly contractor payment applications.
* **Support Preconstruction:** Assist with contractor bidding, bid leveling, scope reviews, and tracking long-lead materials.
* **On-Site Quality Control:** Travel to active construction sites to monitor progress. You will pay close attention to our high-end finishes, including custom millwork, specialty lighting, luxury tiling, and athletic flooring.
* **Drive Closeout & Handoff:** Manage punch lists, equipment commissioning, and closeout packages to ensure a seamless handoff to our Operations and Facilities teams.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Haves:**

* **2 to 5 years** of experience in commercial construction, working for a general contractor, owner's representative, architecture firm, or engineering firm.
* **Strong technical fundamentals:** You can confidently read architectural/structural/MEP drawings and understand basic commercial construction sequencing.
* **Proven organizational skills:** You can manage multiple spreadsheets, logs, and competing priorities without letting details slip through the cracks.
* **Travel flexibility:** Ability to travel extensively throughout the U.S. and internationally to oversee active job sites.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in **hospitality, luxury retail, or high-end commercial interiors**.
* Proficiency with industry software like **Procore, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Project**, along with advanced Excel skills.
* OSHA 10/30 certification or LEED credentials.

**Growth & Culture**

We don't expect you to be an assistant forever. This role is deliberately structured as a stepping stone. As you show capability, you will take independent ownership of larger project scopes.

At Equinox, our clubs are the core of our brand. You’ll be building highly sophisticated, design-driven spaces alongside a seasoned team of real estate, architecture, and construction professionals.

**Pay Transparency:** $85K – $110K

 **Additional Information**

**AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:**

* We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
* Complimentary Club membership
* Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

NOTE: This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at https://careers.equinox.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United Kingdom.

new_jobs.description:
**About Curfew Labs**  
Curfew Labs builds software that makes work easier. Our flagship, Curfew Suite, is a family of connected business apps for time, expenses, books, projects and signatures on one account. We build quiet, dependable tools that do the tedious, load-bearing work so people don’t have to worry when they step away.

**The role**  
A 12-week contract to find out where our marketing should go next. This is an analytics role more than a creative one. You’ll set up and run paid campaigns across our advertising channels, make sure every click and sign-up can be traced back to where it came from, and measure what each new customer costs us to win and what they’re worth. Then you’ll tell us, with evidence, which bets to make. Our team handles the creative; you’ll brief it, test it and say what’s working. Expect 20 to 40 hours a week, set together at the start, and a hybrid schedule from our Chicago office.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own our tracking. Set a consistent UTM convention for every link and campaign, and put conversion tracking, ad platform pixels and analytics events in place. The goal is clean attribution from first click to paying customer.
* Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, TikTok, and OpenAI’s ChatGPT ads
* Track customer acquisition cost (CAC) by channel, campaign and audience, alongside conversion rates, return on ad spend and early lifetime value
* Analyze the customer lifecycle, from first visit to sign-up, activation and retention, using funnels and cohorts, and find the patterns behind who stays
* Design and run tests on audiences, offers, landing pages and budgets, with a clear hypothesis and read-out for each
* Build a simple dashboard and a weekly report that say plainly what’s working, what isn’t, and where to move spend
* Brief our team on creative and landing pages based on what the data shows
* Leave the tracking, the dashboard and a written playbook in good order, so the work carries on after the contract

**What you bring**

* Two or more years in performance or growth marketing, ideally for software or online services, with real responsibility for budgets and results
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads, and experience with or a strong interest in ChatGPT ads
* Strong command of UTMs, conversion tracking, pixels and attribution, and of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager or similar
* A track record of measuring CAC, return on ad spend and lifetime value, and of turning the numbers into decisions
* Experience with funnel, cohort and retention analysis; comfort with spreadsheets, and SQL a plus
* A habit of testing before scaling, and of reporting results honestly, including the ones that didn’t work
* A very organized way of working

**Contract details**

* 12 weeks, starting as soon as the right person is found
* 20 to 40 hours a week, agreed at the start based on campaign volume
